title: fix(platform-objects): decide the object capability toggles and validations en-echoes per leaf, and derive the population from the form
body:
Part of #19403

Clause-②: no

Round 8 of the en-echo decision series. The eleven `en` string leaves of `object.fields.enable.*` and `object.fields.validations.*` — nine labels and two helpTexts — were byte copies of their English source in `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES`. They are decided here, one leaf at a time, with the reason recorded for each, and rendered. **33 locale-leaves of judgement.**

Regenerated with **`pnpm i18n:extract`**, never by hand.

## The eleven, and what each was decided against

| leaf | `en` | zh-CN | ja-JP | es-ES | the evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `enable.label` | Enable | 启用 | 有効化 | Habilitar | four authored `Enable X` action labels agree |
| `enable.helpText` | Enable/disable system features | 启用或禁用系统功能 | システム機能の有効/無効 | Activa/desactiva funciones del sistema | both halves have twins; "system features" is the section description one line above |
| `enable.trackHistory.label` | Track History | 历史跟踪 | 履歴追跡 | Seguimiento de historial | ⭐ **exact twin**, identical English, `object.fields['fields.trackHistory'].label` |
| `enable.searchable.label` | Searchable | 可搜索 | 検索可能 | Buscable | ⭐ **two exact twins**, already agreeing with each other |
| `enable.apiEnabled.label` | Api Enabled | 已启用 API | API 有効 | API habilitada | ⚠️ the humanize trap, below; `X Enabled` copied from two authored twins |
| `enable.files.label` | Files | 文件 | ファイル | Archivos | `sys_attachment.fields.file_id.label` |
| `enable.feeds.label` | Feeds | 动态 | フィード | Publicaciones | ⛔ **no authored twin — composed, and the row says so** |
| `enable.activities.label` | Activities | 活动 | アクティビティ | Actividades | the twin is the same feature: "record activity timeline" |
| `enable.clone.label` | Clone | 克隆 | クローン | Clonación | ⛔ **no authored twin — composed, and the row says so** |
| `validations.label` | Validations | 校验规则 | 検証ルール | Validaciones | one twin for the stem; the three locales depart on purpose |
| `validations.helpText` | (the long prose) | … | … | … | ADR-0020, read at the schema; the JSON sample kept byte-identical |

## ⚠️⚠️ The phantom-translation trap, refused in writing

`enable.apiEnabled.label` is `"Api Enabled"`. That is not a considered English rendering: `objectForm` declares **no label** on that field, so the string is manufactured by the extractor's `humanizeFieldPath`. Its correct English is `"API Enabled"`.

⇒ **Fixing the English would differ in bytes, satisfy the echo predicate in all three locales, drop this card's census by a key, and tell a `zh-CN` author nothing.** An echo that stops matching is ⛔ not a leaf that got translated.

It is **not** done here — it would be an edit to `packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts`, outside this round's file surface, and it is a separate act with its own reason that does ⛔ not discharge the translation. The ledger asserts three things so the shortcut cannot be taken quietly: the form declares no label, the two English spellings differ in bytes, and **none of the three renderings is either of them**. Ablation E performs exactly that "fix" and reds two assertions.

## ADR-0020 and the validations schema, read before a word was rendered

The worked JSON example is kept **byte-identical in all three locales** — this catalog's own convention (`({field, operator, value})`, `{name,type,required,description}` are both kept verbatim elsewhere) and load-bearing here, because `type: "script"` is a literal member of the `ValidationRuleSchema` discriminator and `name` must match a snake_case regex. Every claim the prose makes is asserted at the **live** schema:

- `validations` takes an **array** — the same rule passed as a bare object is refused.
- the example parses **verbatim** as a union member.
- **ADR-0020 D1**: `state_machine` is a member whose payload is a required `transitions` **record**; a rendered phrase cannot land in it.
- **ADR-0020 D2**: `type: "workflow"` — the top-level shape that ADR retired — is **refused**.
- ⚠️ **the near-miss is real and cleared**: the prose spells `State-machine` while the value is `state_machine`, and the discriminator refuses the hyphenated, capitalised form ⇒ the prose names a concept, not a value an author writes, so it is rendered.

And the class-(c) question is answered at the schema rather than assumed: every capability key takes a **boolean**, so no rendered word can land in a value, and `ObjectCapabilities` is strict, so a translated **key** is refused with `unrecognized_keys` rather than silently stripped.

## ⭐ One schema key, one rendering

`trackHistory` and `searchable` were **already rendered in this very catalog**, under the identical English string, by an earlier hand — `object.fields['fields.trackHistory'].label` and `object.fields['fields.searchable'].label`, with `field.fields.searchable.label` as a third position agreeing on another panel. Those words are **copied, not composed**, and the copy is asserted, so the positions can only move together.

That pair is also this round's sharpest evidence the echoes were fills: the same English string, the same schema key, one position authored and the other a byte copy. One leaf cannot be a decision and a fill at once.

Deliberately **untouched**, and asserted so: `object.sections.capabilities.label` (功能开关 / 機能 / Capacidades — the feature-toggle heading round 6 left alone) and `hook`/`action` `.fields.body.capabilities.label` (能力 / ケイパビリティ — round 6's token list, round 7's third position). `enable.label` is asserted **distinguishable** from its own section heading in every locale, and `feeds` from `activities` and from the authored Timeline rendering.

## The population is DERIVED from the FORM, and it sees a two-locale echo

Round 7 raised the bar to "a shape over a spec-side source that manufactures the leaves". This round keeps it there with the source that manufactures these eleven: **`objectForm`, crossed with one predicate read off its own shape — a section is in when the form ships it `collapsed: true`** — walked by the same recursion the CLI extractor uses to emit these keys. Two of four sections qualify. **45 leaves.**

⛔ What the predicate is **not**: an explanation. The open `fields` section was a wall of en-echoes too, until round 1 of this card decided it. The open sections are authored because rounds of this card authored them. The predicate earns its place by deriving and by excluding, not by a causal story.

Three controls, all in the same walk:

| control | what it excludes / produces | measured |
|:--|:--|--:|
| **OUTWARD** | the 2 open sections, with `fields.placeholder` — a key #19403's body samples — asserted **out by name**, and already authored, so a walk that wrongly swept it in would not even go red | 94 leaves, **0** echoing |
| **INWARD, authored** | `datasource` is **inside** the population and comes back **non-echoing** in all three locales | 2 leaves |
| ⭐⭐ **INWARD, two-locale** | `lifecycle.*` comes back echoing in `ja-JP` and `es-ES` while `zh-CN` has all 32 authored — a whole panel the card's all-three predicate reads as **zero** | **32 leaves**, carried as a declared deferral |

The deferral is written as a **shape**, never as 64 hand-listed strings, and the assertion over it is **shrink-only**: nothing outside it may echo. So round 9 emptying it leaves this file green, while a new row arriving in a collapsed section reds it on the day it lands.

## The round 9 re-measure this round owed

The claim's `16 keys × 2 locales = 32 locale-leaves` reading **still holds** on base `1f69917c5`, and the second witness agrees exactly: all 32 are carried in the `ja-JP` and `es-ES` source-hash companions and in **neither** the `zh-CN` bundle nor its companion.

⚠️ **But it is a `.label` reading, and the full-leaf reading is double.** `lifecycle.*` has **32 `en` leaves** — 16 labels and 16 helpTexts, every one of them echoing in both locales ⇒ **64 locale-leaves**, not 32. That is this card's own recorded hazard ("the headline number measures the wrong thing") applying to its own handoff table.

**The complete remaining decidable population of these catalogs, per locale, on this head:**

| echoing in | `en` leaves | which |
|:--|--:|:--|
| all three | **6** | `report.sections.dataset_binding` · `report.fields.drilldown` · `report.fields.runtimeFilter` (label + description/helpText each) |
| exactly two (`ja-JP`, `es-ES`) | **33** | `object.fields.lifecycle.*` (32) · `email_template.fields.variables.helpText` (1) |
| exactly one | **0** | — |
| none | 854 | |

## Measured — every reading re-taken on this base, ⛔ none inherited

Census over `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, `.label` leaves against `en`:

| reading | base `1f69917c5` | head `c49a182d5` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `en` string leaves / `.label` leaves | 893 / 538 | 893 / 538 |
| label keys echoing in **all three** | **12** ⇒ 36 leaves | **3** ⇒ **9** |
| ⭐ POSITIVE CONTROL — genuinely translated | 526 · 510 · 510 | **535 · 519 · 519** |
| decidable remainder (every leaf, `helpText` included) | 17 | **6** |

⭐ The headline drops by **9** and the remainder by **11**, because this round decides nine labels **and** two helpTexts. State which count you mean.

**Second witness** — the `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` companions, under the `metadataForms.` prefix the bundles do not carry (a naive comparison reads 0 for everything):

| locale | echoing → in companion | ⭐ translated → in companion | ⛔ dark: no prefix |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `zh-CN` | 3 → **3** | 535 → **0** | **0** |
| `ja-JP` | 19 → **19** | 519 → **0** | **0** |
| `es-ES` | 19 → **19** | 519 → **0** | **0** |

`pnpm i18n:extract` dropped exactly the **11 rows per locale / 33 in total** for these leaves and **added none**.

**Add and remove no keys** — the full flattened key sets, base vs head, on all four bundles:

```
bundle   base  head   added removed   values-changed
en       893   893    0     0         0
zh-CN    893   893    0     0         11
ja-JP    893   893    0     0         11
es-ES    893   893    0     0         11
```

⭐ NEGATIVE CONTROL, both directions: fed a set with one key added, the comparator reports `added 1 / removed 0`; fed one with a key removed, `added 0 / removed 1`. It can see a one-key delta either way.

⭐ And a second proof the edits are values-only: re-running `pnpm i18n:extract` after them rewrote all eleven generated files and **only the three companions changed** — the bundles came back byte-identical to the hand edits, so no structure was touched.

## The changeset is a `patch`, and `skip-changeset` is measurably wrong

`@objectstack/platform-objects` declares no `private` and ships `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`. The renderings measurably reach those files — probed with every escape spelling **built from the character itself**, so no shell layer can interpret it:

| subject | raw | `\uXXXX` UPPER | `\uxxxx` lower | `\xNN` UPPER | `\xnn` lower |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| zh `已启用 API` | 0 | **6** | 0 | — | — |
| ja `フィード` | 0 | **6** | 0 | — | — |
| es `Clonación` | 0 | 0 | 0 | **6** | 0 |
| ⭐ es `Publicaciones` (ASCII, **raw negative control**) | **6** | — | — | — | — |
| ⛔ a string never written (dark control) | **0** | — | — | — | — |

⇒ the ASCII control **fires raw**, so a zero on a raw non-ASCII probe reads 「escaped」 and ⛔ not 「absent」; and the dark control reads 0, so the probe can say NO. CJK and kana land as **UPPER-CASE `\uXXXX`**; U+0080–U+00FF lands as **UPPER-CASE `\xNN`**. ⚠️ And the same character has two spellings inside one `files[]` set: `克隆` is raw in `dist/system/index.d.ts` while escaped in `dist/index.js`.

## Ablations — 5 mutations, 10 distinct assertions, two files

Every leg proved the mutation on disk (anchor count + blob hash), and every restore proved by blob hash **and** a whole-tree `git status --porcelain`. `ablation-replace.mjs` throughout; never `sed -i`.

| # | file | mutation | assertions reddened |
|:--|:--|:--|--:|
| **A** | `zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` | re-fill a **decided** leaf (`enable.clone`) | **3** |
| **B** | `ja-JP.metadata-forms.generated.ts` | re-fill the **inward control** (`datasource`) — a leaf **no row decides** | **2** |
| **C** | `zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` | reword the **authored twin** `fields.trackHistory` | **1** |
| **D** | `packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts` | flip `collapsed` on the `advanced` section | **5** |
| **E** | `packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts` | **take the phantom shortcut** — add `label: 'API Enabled'` | **2** |

⭐ **C and D/E prove the two legs independent.** Rewording a catalog twin reds **only** the cross-panel invariant, leaving all eleven decided rows green. Mutating the spec-side form reds the derivation, the three dark controls and the third leg, leaving the catalog rows green.

⭐ **D and E are real dist ablations**, because this ledger imports `@objectstack/spec/data` unaliased and so resolves through `spec/dist` — unlike the bundle legs, whose subject is a sibling source. Each carried a **rebuild** and a `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` run on both legs (marker present before the verdict, marker `--absent` after the restore). Stated as a measurement, not an omission.

⛔ **Two disclosures, volunteered:**

1. **D's first marker was `collapsed: false`, which PRE-EXISTS 6 times in `packages/spec/dist`.** Caught by checking the marker's baseline occurrence count **before** running, so no reading was taken from it. Re-authored to a unique `ABLATION_D_ADVANCED_OPEN` token.
2. **E's restore leg was REFUSED by the preflight** — the marker was spelled `label: "API Enabled"` (the dist spelling) while the source carries single quotes, so the tool could not see the marker in the dirty source and reported the tree unrestored. The mutation was **re-authored** to carry a quote-agnostic token that is identical in source and dist, ⛔ not re-run until something landed. The label's own dist spelling was then preflighted separately, present and absent.

## Gates

**60 derived / 60 run / 0 NOT MEASURED / 0 UNRUN**, every one exit **0**, reconciled with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran` over a record that carries each command's exit code, captured **before** any pipe.

**One exit 3, discharged rather than waved past**: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` refused its own prerequisite (12 packages with no `dist`). The closure it names was built — `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2`, 74/74 tasks — and the gate re-run to exit **0** (104 require entry points across 67 packages load; 620 emitted CJS files parse).

Also green, outside the derived set: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` (**52 files / 813 tests**), its `typecheck`, and repo-wide `eslint . --no-inline-config` over **6980 files / 0 messages** — the full population, so ⛔ no narrowing is claimed.

## Merge duty

`git fetch origin main` then `git merge origin/main`, performed immediately before the final push: **`Already up to date`**. `origin/main` is `1f69917c5` both at worktree creation and now, so it did not move during this round. ⇒ the two-legged proof (base ≠ main **and** head == main) is **not applicable here and is not claimed** — leg 1 reads **0 changed paths** over this region, which is the honest reading rather than a proof that was never needed. `HEAD` vs `main` over the region is exactly this round's 8 files.

⚠️ **The card's merge hazard re-measured on this base and it still holds**: `git check-attr merge` reads `unspecified` for `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, while the control `packages/spec/spec-changes.json` reads `os-regen`. Two branches each adding keys here would merge exit 0 with one side silently lost. Routing those paths is an `AGENTS.md` decision and ⛔ not this card's — recorded, not acted on. No `os-regen-pending` deferral is owed by this branch.

## ⚠️ One in-place repair, declared

`bare-type-display-echo-decisions.test.ts` (round 7) went **red on this round's progress**: its provenance control carried `expect(formKeys.length).toBeGreaterThan(10)`, and this round took `zh-CN`'s metadata-form provenance slice from 12 rows to **6**. That is a landed assertion this diff makes false, so it is fixed here rather than filed.

The floor is **removed, not lowered** — it is a reading that expires by design, because every landing of this card shrinks that slice — and the leg-3 discrimination is re-seeded off the whole table instead of its metadata-form slice. Same repair applied in this round's own ledger before it was written: its discrimination runs over the **objects** catalog, a population this card does not touch, with a real positive **and** a real negative in every locale (every echoing objects leaf carries a row, every authored one carries none).

## Acceptance notes

- **The `*.objects.generated.ts` catalogs carry a far larger echo population that no census on this card counts.** Measured here as a by-product of building the provenance control: **362** (`zh-CN`) · **383** (`ja-JP`) · **392** (`es-ES`) `en`-echoing leaves, each carrying a source-hash row, against 1203 · 1182 · 1173 genuinely translated. `objects.sys_session.fields.last_activity_at.label` is one example met while hunting twins. This card's population is the metadata-form catalogs only, and this one has no declared carrier — recorded here rather than assumed to be someone's.
- **`humanizeFieldPath` is the producer for every unlabelled form field**, so "Api Enabled" is one instance of a general shape, not a one-off typo. Nothing here surveys the other unlabelled fields for the same defect.
